text: Albert, a U.S.-based fintech, raised $100 million in a Series C funding round led by General Atlantic with participation from CapitalG, Alphabet's independent growth fund, Portag3 and QED, bringing Albert's total funding to $173 million.
short: Albert's $100M Series C (2021) was led by General Atlantic; CapitalG, Portag3 and QED joined.

source.name: Crowdfund Insider: U.S. Fintech Albert Raises $100 Million Through Series C Funding Round Led By General Atlantic
